description.en: The startup parameter of the process.

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 进程名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为1，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询。
description.en: Specifies whether fuzzy search by process name is supported. If you want to use fuzzy search, set the parameter to 1. If you set the parameter to a different value or leave the parameter empty, fuzzy search is not supported.

description.zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

> 第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken。
description.en: The value of NextToken that is returned when the NextToken method is used. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的进程资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为**10**，表示每页显示10条进程资产的指纹信息。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

description.zh: 进程启动结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The timestamp when the process ends. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 进程启动开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒。
description.en: The timestamp when the process starts. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址。
description.en: The name or IP address of the server.

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the account ID.

description.zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

- **true**：使用NextToken方式。
- **false**：不使用NextToken方式。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve a new page of results. If you set UseNextToken to true, the value of TotalCount is not returned. Valid values:

- **true**: The NextToken method is used.
- **false**: The NextToken method is not used.

description.zh: 运行进程的用户的信息。
description.en: The user who runs the process.

title.zh: 查询进程资产的资产指纹
title.en: Query Asset Fingerprint of Process Assets
